name: Primal Downpour
description: Draw a downpour of old storm out of the sky and drive it onto the ground in one long fall.

name: Tempest Mantle
description: Wear a towering mantle of live storm that stands between the user and every blow.

name: Thunder Rebuke
description: Meet a technique in the air with a peal that turns it and sends it back on its maker.

name: Weather Chorus
description: Raise a chorus of wind and rain and thunder behind allies that strengthens each of them.

name: Tempest Eye
description: Fix the calm eye of the storm on one foe and let the full force round it fall through his defences.

name: Thunder Phase
description: Turn into charge for a breath and pass through a strike or a barrier before taking shape again.

name: Tempest Siphon
description: Drink the force of hostile weather and technique into the body and pass it to allies as strength.

name: Cyclone Judgment
description: Wind a cyclone over the field that drags the foes together and judges them in its spin.

name: Thunderous Verdict
description: The school's closing move that sets one peal of thunder through the foe with a weight that scales with the user's reserve.

name: Tempest Decree
description: The school's ruling move that decrees the tempest over the whole field with a weight that scales with the user's reserve.

name: Squall Edict
description: The school's swift move that issues the edict in one short squall with a weight that scales with the user's reserve.

name: Calamity Storm
description: Bring a calamity of weather down on a wide land to the destructive ceiling of the user's tier.

name: Weather Unbound
description: Wake the storm as a thing with its own will that hunts one chosen foe past any ward; each use is a consequence event.
